title: Island Components Group: Phase 56I First-Pass Decision
summary: The selected SCIDA record defines a $2 million relocation, a 14,200-square-foot Hauppauge facility, and fourteen planned engineering and manufacturing positions. Phase 56I decision: The first pass remains Partially Closed. The record establishes planned facility, capital, and jobs but does not report realized employment, completed investment, or repeat production output.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Realized facility, capital, and employment inputs paired with repeat output.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when SCIDA, the company, a registrar, or a customer publishes a dated realized outcome for the Hauppauge operation.
why_it_matters: The first-pass decision records whether a named official rail supplies the required denominator without converting adjacent or partial evidence into false closure.
ftfn_relevance: Completes the Phase 56I first-pass queue under a dated source check.
Keeps evidence state separate from performance, safety, quality, readiness, and value.
evidence_limits: A project description and planned employment increment are not realized jobs, completed investment, operating output, quality, delivery, or independently validated productivity.
Realized jobs, completed investment, output, labor hours, WIP, yield, defects, downtime, delivery, demand, and independent surveillance findings.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
